title: Marie Garnier PhD Research Project
descriptions: Dataset of relevant newspaper articles that are the primary data underlying the doctoral research project of Marie Garnier. This dataset includes the following files: (1) Metadata file (text file, information to understand the dataset) (2) Bilbiographic information file (markup language text file, bibliographic information of newspaper articles retrieved and included) (3) Coding handbook (text file) (4) Raw dataset (qualitative data analysis file, newspaper articles included in content analysis) (5) Processed dataset (qualitative data analysis file, coded newspaper articles included in content analysis)

relations.text: The Chick Diffusion: How Newspapers Fail to Meet Normative Expectations Regarding Their Democratic Role in Public Debate
Something wicked this way comes: How well did UK newspapers support the public debate of Avian Influenza as a wicked problem?

data_sources: Bibliographic information for each newspaper article is included in a separate file. Additionally, the metadata file contains the search string used to retrieve the articles, the information on when and where the articles were retrieved, and the set of inclusion and exclusion criteria used to narrow down the dataset to the final set of articles finally included in the analysis.
